title: Guidelines on handling disasters to be released next week | The Star
text: Guidelines on handling disasters to be released next week | The Star × View Nation Guidelines on handling disasters to be released next week By PATRICK LEE Monday, 26 Oct 2015 | 12:00 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Animals 11h ago Invasive green crabs are bad for the environment so these folks are eating them Nation 1d ago No shame in seeking healthier professional environment Metro News 28 Sep 2026 Young Malaysians learn to preserve environment through games KUALA LUMPUR: A “how to” on handling disasters, especially floods, is expected to be released to the public next week. Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department Datuk Seri Shahidan Kassim said a standard operating procedure (SOP) on disasters would be out after a Cabinet endorsement. Already a subscriber?
